items.claim: quatrefoil `samples` had no bound, so Infinity hung the page and NaN threw
beavis `points` skipped `repeatCount`, so Infinity or NaN drew NaN spikes
receipt `tearDepth` had no upper bound, so the two tears crossed
house `peakHeight` had no upper bound, so the roof rose out of the box
composed shapes' declared `insets` were never read, so house, coffin, hexagon and others took the base's padding
items.note: (ribbon now reads its base's taper insets; square declares the 0/4/0/4 it already drew with)

items.claim: NaN in a clamped continuous param reached the drawn path
items.note: (also perforated `holeRadius`, starburst `erosion`, and the coffin, house, hexagon, notched and shield clamps)

items.claim: `SHAPES` is a plain object, so `"constructor"` resolved through Object.prototype
items.note: (`BASES` and `EFFECTS` had the same lookup and got the same null-prototype table)

items.claim: beavis `cornerRadius` scaled with the badge's height instead of staying in px
items.note: (adds a px `radius` to the `rounded-rect` base, with a `minor` `api` changeset)
duplicate of A's receipt finding, fixed 4ea1055104

items.claim: Notched corner arcs overran the badge at eccentricity ≠ 1
Perforated hung at `holePitch` 0 and minted unbounded holes for a tiny pitch
Shield top-corner arcs reached below the shoulder or past half the width
Coffin read `shoulderHalfHeight` as an increment over the head's
items.note: It is now an absolute half-height with a default of 50, which draws the same coffin as before, and ui-lab's slider now spans 2..50. Recorded in `docs/unruled.md` as a behavior call nobody has ruled on.

items.claim: Sparkler and Starburst did not validate `points` (0, fractional, Infinity)
items.note: A shared `repeatCount` floors the count and holds it to 3..256. Receipt's `teeth` gets the same 256 cap; the cap is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: A `shapeParams` key set to undefined overrode the default and gave NaN geometry
items.note: A shared `withDefaults` now does the merge in every shape and in `Badge.tsx`'s merge.
